newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Eastern offers firm on rail.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Eastern offers firm on rail.

text.p: Offers for on-track soymeal in the eastern Corn Belt were higher on Monday on tight supplies and end-of-month factors while meal quotes elsewhere for truck and rail were steady to lower on soybean harvest prospects, cashdealers said.

"There's not a lot of demand anywhere right now, with processors and consumers trying to get to the end of the month," said one Indiana meal broker. "But CSX rail rates are expected to go up on Oct 1, so quick shipment gets a premium."
Weekend rains aided central Midwest soybean development and pushed down processor bids for beans.
Minnesota and Kansas rail meal offers softened as the crop outlook improved.
Export markets remain quiet, with overseas buyers holding the same posture as domestic users of meal.
"They're buying hand-to-mouth only," said a Kentucky-based export trader.
